summary: Iteration 89: Comprehensive testing of MoneySSutra with seeded data. All features working correctly - Add Income back button navigates to /my-income, Dashboard shows positive net worth (₹1.49Cr), Insights page has Badges and Challenges always unlocked, and all data modules have seeded data.

integration_issues.flow: Expense Calendar and My Expenses loading
integration_issues.issue: Calendar shows 'Loading...' state and My Expenses shows '0 expenses this month' in header despite having data in breakdown section (Fixed: ₹2.61L/36 expenses, Variable: ₹35.1K/8 expenses). The expense breakdown shows data correctly but the individual expense list shows Loading state.
integration_issues.note: This appears to be a display/loading state issue - the data exists (visible in breakdown) but isn't rendering in the list view

action_items: INVESTIGATE: Expense list shows 'Loading...' state while breakdown shows data - possible async loading issue in My Expenses page
